endpoints.label: GO term lookup by id(s)
endpoints.describes: GO term details by GO id(s). Comma-separated, e.g. 'GO:0008150,GO:0003674,GO:0005575' (BP, MF, CC roots).

endpoints.label: GO term ancestors
endpoints.describes: All ancestor terms up to the namespace root. Useful for collapsing fine-grained GO terms to broader categories for enrichment narratives.

endpoints.label: GO term direct children
endpoints.describes: Immediate child terms only (one level down). Combine repeated calls for tree walks.

endpoints.label: Annotation search (by gene product / GO id / taxon)
endpoints.describes: Filter GO annotations by gene product id (UniProt), GO id, or NCBI taxon id. At least one filter is required; the upstream rejects empty searches. For catfish, taxonId=2787823 (Clarias gariepinus).
